actions.reason: C0001 shows a coherent PBRM1/VHL-mutant, BAP1-wildtype molecular profile with the strongest signal in WXS, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. Cross-modal membership support is weak and fused resampling stability is modest, so structural uncertainty remains, but no positive evidence indicates a reproducible subdivision or insufficient separation from another set, and no available request could resolve this. Retain for downstream validation.

C0002 has a coherent metabolic-downregulation RNA signature with PTEN/ATM/SETD2/PBRM1 mutation enrichment, moderate cross-modal membership support, reasonable fused resampling stability, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. No material unresolved question or better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0003 shows a coherent 3p/12p copy-number loss pattern with directionally consistent mutation evidence, moderate cross-modal membership support, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. Fused resampling stability is weaker, so structural uncertainty remains, but no positive evidence supports a reproducible split or merge and no available request could resolve this. Retain for downstream validation.

C0004 has a strong coherent immune/inflammatory-up RNA signature with BAP1-mutant, PBRM1-wildtype mutation pattern, moderate cross-modal membership support, reasonable fused resampling stability, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. No material unresolved question or better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0005 has a coherent VHL-mutant, PBRM1-wildtype mutation profile, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. Membership support is driven almost entirely by WXS with other modalities near zero, so structural uncertainty remains, but no positive evidence supports a reproducible split or merge and no available request could resolve this. Retain for downstream validation.

C0006 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype mutation profile, no technical confounder association, and low stage/grade echo. Membership support is driven almost entirely by WXS with other modalities near zero, so structural uncertainty remains, but no positive evidence supports a reproducible split or merge and no available request could resolve this. Retain for downstream validation.
